source_contract.selection: intersection of the matched DriveWAM/Epona source_key set
source_contract.action_contract: identical eight-point DriveWAM action trajectories injected into both WAMs
source_contract.randomness_contract: unchanged from the archived matched runs

degradation.name: counterfactual_pixel_contrast_attenuation
degradation.scope: future RGB frames only; history, actions, timestamps and calibration remain fixed

acceptance_criteria.full_attenuation_pixel_identity: left and right future frames must be byte-identical
acceptance_criteria.pass_scope: all criteria must pass independently for both models

interpretation_boundary: This validates sensitivity to a known loss of counterfactual visual contrast; it does not establish logged-GT fidelity or rank two naturally generated WAMs.
